fields.expression: [s EXCEPT !.requests = [id \in DOMAIN s.requests |-> LET r == s.requests[id] IN IF r.phase \in {"unused", "response", "done"} THEN LET SlopIntakeReadbackSafe == (r.status = 200 => (rowAt(r.returnedRow).exists /\ r.returnedPayload = rowAt(r.returnedRow).payload)) IN <<r.phase, r.attempt, IF r.attempt > 0 /\ r.attempt < 2 THEN <<r.mode, r.key, r.parent, r.payload, r.bundle>> ELSE <<>>, r.status = 200, SlopIntakeReadbackSafe, IF SlopIntakeReadbackSafe THEN <<0, 0>> ELSE <<r.returnedRow, r.returnedPayload>>, (r.status > 0 => r.noStore), (r.refreshed \subseteq r.collected), (r.collected \subseteq r.members)>> ELSE IF r.phase \in {"prepare", "preflight", "append", "readback"} THEN <<"post-refresh", [r EXCEPT !.received = FALSE, !.sourceRevisions = [sourceId \in DOMAIN r.sourceRevisions |-> 0], !.collected = {}, !.refreshed = {}], (r.refreshed \subseteq r.collected), (r.collected \subseteq r.members)>> ELSE [r EXCEPT !.received = FALSE]]]
